scope: Recorded campaign control-weight points at the retained structure; descriptive association only.
statement: Sampled holding speed at the frozen structure is not monotone in the frozen control tip-speed weights: higher holding penalties recorded higher sampled holding speed, and the one control-weight change that lowered holding speed did so while enlarging terminal and holding position error. Control-only adaptation therefore currently yields only trade-offs or failures, which motivates an isolated structural probe at frozen weights.
uncertainty: Single executions, confounded representation differences between initializer records, and only two weight values per axis executed; no monotonicity, causality or continuous-time claim is made.
